observations: Photos show a Yamaha electronic keyboard with built-in speaker grille on the right side.
Photo 2 shows the front control panel with many buttons/knobs and the brand name 'YAMAHA' on the front edge.
No photo clearly shows the model number 'SX-600' on the keyboard or label.
No photo shows the adapter/power supply, ports, or any screen/display.
No photo shows any test of keys, sound output, or button functionality.

claims.evidence: Photos show a keyboard with no obvious major damage, but overall condition (scratches, wear, missing parts) is not fully verifiable from these angles.
No audio/video or functional test is shown in the photos; seller’s new message is not proof.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included.
claims.evidence: No adapter is shown; no key/button test is shown.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: Origin and absence of dead keys/crackle cannot be confirmed from photos.

claims.claim: No o, I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true. Please check again.
claims.evidence: Seller asserts testing, but provides no new photo/video evidence.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (photos don’t confirm SX-600; could be another Yamaha model with similar layout).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label showing 'SX-600' (usually back panel/underside).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha keyboard of unknown exact model (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Not actually fully working (dead keys, intermittent buttons, or crackling sounds).
risks.proof: Short video with audio: play a full octave scale and press every button/slider; include built-in speaker output (and headphone/line-out if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: treat as needing service).

risks.risk: Adapter/power supply not included or wrong voltage/connector.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter and its label (voltage/amp) plus a shot of it connected to the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not included (buyer must source one).

risks.risk: Hidden physical issues (loose keys, damaged speaker, broken casing) not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel/ports and underside; close-up of speaker area and any visible seams/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible cosmetic wear and potential minor faults not shown.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model label showing 'SX-600'.
Video test with audio: full key range (no dead keys) and button/knob presses (no crackle).
Photo of the adapter and its specs, and a shot of it connected to the keyboard.
Back/underside photos showing ports and any damage.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable remotely without new evidence; the photos still don’t confirm the exact 'SX-600' model or show adapter inclusion and functional key/button/audio tests.
